outputs.01-ingest-bad-signature:
Summary: Rotating the webhook secret caused every GitHub delivery to return a 401 with “invalid signature,” preventing any events from reaching the jobs queue.  
Likely area: signature verification in the webhook handler.  
Suggested label: bug  

We will fix this by next Tuesday.
outputs.02-ingest-duplicate-delivery:
Summary: Redelivering an issue webhook enqueues the same issue twice, despite the X‑GitHub‑Delivery id meant to dedupe it.  
Likely area: webhook handling / deduplication logic  
Suggested label: bug  

The team will fix it by Friday.
outputs.03-worker-crash-loop:
Summary: The worker logs an error when a job body lacks an `issue_number` and after three attempts the job disappears without being dead‑lettered or recovered.  
Likely area: Job processing / worker resilience.  
Suggested label: bug  

The team will look into this and aim to fix it by next Tuesday.
outputs.04-mcp-401-cursor:
Summary: Cursor cannot connect to the MCP server and receives a 401 error with a resource_metadata header, resulting in a “Needs login” message and no browser launch.  
Likely area: MCP authentication and connection handling.  
Suggested label: authentication.  

The team will fix this by Friday.
outputs.05-approve-wrong-hash:
Summary: The user tried to approve a pending action and received a “payload hash mismatch” error, suggesting the payload may have changed between listing and approving.

Likely area: action approval / payload verification logic.

Suggested label: bug

The team will investigate and fix this by Thursday.
outputs.06-effector-double-comment:
Summary: Same triage comment appears twice on issue #12 due to a GitHub outage.  
Likely area: Bot comment duplication logic.  
Suggested label: bug  
The team will fix it by Friday.
outputs.07-effector-stuck-claimed:
Summary: The approval is processed, status shows as approved, but the effects row stays in a “claimed” state without an external_id for 20 minutes and no related activity appears on GitHub.  
Likely area: Backend processing / effects handling.  
Suggested label: bug  

The team will fix this by Wednesday.
outputs.08-rls-other-owner:
Summary: The issue is that the `list_pending_actions` API only returns pending actions for the current maintainer’s agent, so a second maintainer cannot see or approve the other owner’s actions.  
Likely area: Agent permissions / approval workflow.  
Suggested label: question.  

We'll investigate this and aim to provide a fix by Wednesday.
outputs.09-docs-hosted-setup:
Summary: The hosted setup guide omits the Vault configuration step, causing the approvals trigger to complain that required Vault secrets are not set.  
Likely area: Documentation / Setup guide.  
Suggested label: documentation  

We’ll update the guide to include the missing Vault step and have it ready by Friday.
outputs.10-feature-slack:
Summary: The feature request asks for a Slack notification when a draft is pending approval.  
Likely area: Notification subsystem / approval workflow integration.  
Suggested label: enhancement  
The team will fix it by Thursday.
outputs.11-evals-flaky:
Summary: A PR that only changes the README triggers a red eval gate job with the error “no usable recording for config_hash”.  
Likely area: CI / eval gate job configuration.  
Suggested label: ci  
We’ll look into this and have it resolved by Friday.
outputs.12-perf-queue-backlog:
Summary: When 200 issues are imported at once, the job queue backlogs and drafts arrive an hour later because a single worker processes jobs serially.  
Likely area: job queue / worker processing.  
Suggested label: performance.  
The team will address this and aim to resolve it by Friday.
outputs.13-security-token-scope:
Summary: The worker’s environment is using a classic PAT with repo scope, which allows it to write issues and thus violates the intended read‑only access.  
Likely area: Authentication & Authorization (security).  
Suggested label: security.  

Rest assured, we’ll update the worker’s token permissions to enforce read‑only access, and we expect to have this fixed by Tuesday.
outputs.14-question-model-choice:
Summary: The issue asks which model triage-drafter uses for summary generation and why it was chosen.  
Likely area: Model selection and configuration.  
Suggested label: question  

We'll investigate this and share an update by Friday.
outputs.15-vague-report:
Summary: The reporter says that the current version of the application isn’t working, whereas version 3 was fine.  
Likely area: Core functionality / regression.  
Suggested label: bug  
Thanks for bringing this to our attention, the team will work on a fix and it will be resolved by Friday.
